request.style: English, jazz, female soulful voice solo with subtle choir, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, warm intimate mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Everything is naked and exposed
Before the eyes of the one
To whom we must give account
No creature can be hidden

[Verse]
We hold fast to our confession
Our high priest passed through the heavens
Jesus the Son of God
Able to sympathize with us

[Chorus]
Approach the throne of grace with confidence
Receive mercy in your time of need
Find grace to help you now
With confidence approach the throne

[Verse]
Tempted in every way as we are
Yet without sin he remains
A great high priest for us
Unable to sympathize is not

[Chorus]
Approach the throne of grace with confidence
Receive mercy in your time of need
Find grace to help you now
With confidence approach the throne

[Bridge]
Our weaknesses are seen
By one who understands
Yet he offers help
In your time of need

[Outro]
Approach the throne of grace
With confidence today
